entries.1b81749a6c492726: The group consists of the company, consolidated subsidiary Yamatoku Co., Ltd., and equity-method affiliates Interpia Co., Ltd. and Top Books Co., Ltd. The headquarters is in Okayama City, Okayama Prefecture, and consolidated employees number 443 (as of February 28, 2026). It operates as a single segment, the Multi-Package Sales Business, buying and selling new and used goods through stores and EC sales channels.
